title: Mortgage rates ease for a third straight week
summary: Freddie Mac's weekly survey put the 30 year fixed rate at 7.18 percent for the week of November 5, down from 7.24 percent the week before and from 7.40 percent in mid October.

title: Northwoods Industrial Park sells in the largest industrial campus sale in Greater Houston
summary: A 2.7 million square foot campus of 64 buildings in Northwest Houston sold to a joint venture between the Adkisson Group and PCCP, according to Stream Realty Partners.
